descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra missione

Il nostro obiettivo aziendale è quello di essere la più focalizzata e innovativa azienda di assistenza orale al mondo. Al centro di avanzare soluzioni di assistenza orale in tutto il mondo, il team di Global Medical Education guida l'empowerment e l'educazione dei nostri partner interni ed esterni per garantire l'adozione e l'applicazione efficace delle innovazioni Straumann.

Il tuo scopo

Il team di Straumann Global Medical Education è responsabile della commercializzazione di successo delle innovazioni Straumann dal punto di vista della formazione e dell'istruzione.

Questa funzione è fondamentale per facilitare esperienze di apprendimento significative che le competenze professionali di cui dispone, ispirare fiducia e, in ultima analisi, migliorare i risultati della cura dei pazienti a livello globale.

Lei svolge un ruolo cruciale nel portare alla vita i nostri programmi educativi implementando e gestendo esperienze pratiche per gli operatori sanitari per alimentare l'uso sicuro delle innovazioni Straumann.

Il tuo impatto

In questo ruolo, permettete di fornire da un lato esperienze di apprendimento efficaci e di sfruttare le vostre forti capacità di modellazione analitica e finanziaria e di gestire con successo il portafoglio di materiali dei corsi Straumann.s.

Cerchiamo un professionista altamente analitico e orientato ai risultati con esperienza in ambienti di dispositivi medici internazionali per condurre:

- L'implementazione end-to-end di nuovi concetti di corso e materiali demo in collaborazione con le organizzazioni interne di gestione dei prodotti e dell'istruzione, Straumann Group supply chain, così come fornitori 3rd party.

- Il portafoglio di materiali e materiali end-to-end end management, in collaborazione con regioni, mercati chiave e selezionare partner di formazione di terze parti.

- Iniziative strategiche di ottimizzazione dei costi per materiali didattici e demo in collaborazione con team interfunzionali, ad esempio finanza, contabilità, approvvigionamento, supply chain, formazione e partner esterni.

Con chi hai il potere di:

In questo ruolo, le seguenti funzioni sono le vostre interfacce principali:

- Team di formazione, gestione dei prodotti e eventi

- 3a parte KOL e coordinatori dei corsi

- Servizi del servizio interno, quali:

- Ingegneria per lo sviluppo del materiale didattico

- Logistica per la movimentazione dei materiali di corso

- Magazzino per la gestione dell'inventario dei materiali

Indicatori di prestazione chiave (KPI):

KPI finanziari

- Gestire e ridurre i COGS, gestire i margini e i costi operativi per materiali di corso e demo

- Risparmio annuo realizzato rispetto al basale

- Aumento del numero di corsi effettuati nei bilanci esistenti

KPI operativi

- Sostegno alla previsione e alla pianificazione della domanda

- Implementare kit pratici per l'esercizio

- Ottimizzare e semplificare i portafogli dei modelli di formazione

- Aumentare l'adozione di alternative ai modelli animali e cadaveri

- Migliorare la standardizzazione tra paesi e regioni

La tua qualifica ed esperienza

- MBA o equivalente laurea in Amministrazione aziendale, Finanza, Operazioni o campo correlato

- 5+ anni di esperienza nello spazio odontoiatrico all'interno di dispositivi medici internazionali o organizzazioni sanitarie

- Proven track record in ottimizzazione dei costi, gestione snella, e trasformazione operativa

- Esperienza lavorando in organizzazioni a matrice globale

- Capacità di guidare iniziative interfunzionali e cambiamenti organizzativi

- Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

- Competenza con i programmi MS Office

- La conoscenza dell'implantologia dentale e dei flussi di lavoro clinici digitali sono un vantaggio forte.

- La fluidità in inglese è obbligatoria. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio.

Attributi personali

Our Mission


Our company goal is to be the most customer focused and innovative oral care company in the world. At the heart of advancing oral care solutions worldwide, the Global Medical Education team drives the empowerment and education of our internal and external partners to ensure the effective adoption and application of Straumann innovations.

Your Purpose

The Straumann Global Medical Education team is responsible for the successful commercialization of Straumann innovations from a training and education perspective.

This function is vital to facilitate meaningful learning experiences that elevate professional skills, inspire confidence, and ultimately improve patient care outcomes globally.

You play a crucial role in bringing our education programs to life by implementing and managing hands-on experiences for healthcare professionals to nurture confident use of Straumann innovations.

Your Impact

In this role, you enable the end-to-end delivery of impactful learning experiences and exploit your strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities and excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills to manage Straumann’s course materials portfolio.

We seek a highly analytical and results oriented professional with experience in international medical device environments to lead:

  • The end-to-end implementation of new course and demo materials concepts in collaboration with internal product and education management organizations, Straumann Group supply chain, as well as 3rd party vendors.
  • The end-to-end lean management of course & demo materials portfolio in collaboration with regions, key markets and select 3rd party education partners.
  • Strategic cost optimization initiatives for course and demo materials in collaboration with cross-functional teams, i.e. finance, accounting, procurement, supply chain, education and external partners.

Who You’ll Collaborate With:

In this role, the following functions are your main interfaces:

  • Global education, product management, and events teams
  • 3rd Party KOLs and course coordinators
  • Internal service departments, such as:
    • Engineering for course material development
    • Logistics for course materials handling
    • Warehouse for course materials inventory management

Your Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Financial KPIs

  • Manage and reduce COGS, handling mark-ups, and operational costs for course and demo materials
  • Annual realized savings versus baseline
  • Increased number of courses delivered within existing budgets

Operational KPIs

  • Support forecasting and demand planning
  • Implement hands-on exercise kits
  • Optimize and simplify training model portfolios
  • Increase adoption of alternatives to animal and cadaver models
  • Improve standardization across countries and regions

Your • Qualifications & Experience

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in dentistry space within international medical device or healthcare organizations
  • Proven track record in cost optimization, lean management, and operational transformation
  • Experience working in global matrix organizations
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and organizational change
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Competence working with MS Office programs
  • Knowledge of dental implantology and digital clinical workflows are a strong plus.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Other languages are an advantage.

Personal Attributes

  • Motivated self-starter
  • Team-spirited, structured, results oriented and pragmatic approach to work
  • Strong communication and listening skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to nurture effective in person or remote working relationship
  • Ability to travel (est. 15%)

Please note that this role is based in Basel and its hybrid working model with 2 remote working days/week


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Job Purpose

The Senior Growth Lead for Single Tooth Solutions at Straumann is accountable for defining and driving the strategic direction and commercial success of the Straumann Single Tooth Indication area. This role ensures that the indication area delivers sustainable growth through clear business cases, differentiated value propositions, and effective go-to-market (GTM) execution. Within this framework, a key responsibility is the successful commercialization of end-to-end clinical workflows.
The position holder can also contribute or temporarily lead initiatives related to other indications (Fixed Full Arch, Removable Full Arch).

Main Tasks and • Responsibilities

  1. Own the indication growth plan and business case, ensuring alignment with the overall business objectives and portfolio strategy (Business Book).
  2. Ensure alignment on business goals and indication growth plan priorities across IBU, CCS, and regions.
  3. Translate market and customer insights into actionable strategies that strengthen Straumann’s competitive position and long-term success.
  4. Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies, including positioning, messaging, pricing, and channel mix, to increase customer value and NCA.
  5. Lead launch excellence planning and execution: commercial readiness deliverables as defined in Launch Process.
  6. Develop and oversee commercial deliverables: claims and value proposition (in collaboration with Clinical Workflows Team and Development PM Team), branding, and communication strategy (in coordination with SDIS Marketing and Global MarCom), marketing assets, campaigns, sales tools, training decks.
  7. Plan and execute brand medical marketing strategies, integrating scientific evidence, clinical studies, and KOL input.
  8. Ensure alignment of the roadmap with business objectives and manage portfolio coherence within the indication area, including lifecycle management.
  9. Maximize revenues and profitability of in-market products.
  10. Ensure alignment between global and regional teams through clear targets, roles, and performance tracking mechanisms.
  11. Build and manage relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and the dental community to foster advocacy and clinical credibility.

• Requirements needed


• A degree in marketing, business, engineering or related fields.
• At least 5 years of experience in growth marketing, product management, or a similar roles, preferably in the healthcare or dental sector.
• Experience with complex launches on a global scale.
• Commercial acumen.
• Deep understanding of implant dentistry customer behavior, needs, and preferences.
• Data-driven mindset and excellent analytical, with the ability to measure and report on key performance indicators and make data-driven recommendations.
• Strong sense of ownership.
• Capability to align a broad range of stakeholders around a common vision.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.

We are looking for an intern to join our Global Technology and Testing Group in Metallurgy for 6 months. Internship Purpose:

Support the Metallurgy team in preparing, executing, documenting, and evaluating laboratory tests and investigations while learning good laboratory practice in a regulated medical device environment

Main Tasks and • Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and perform metallographic testing, including sample preparation, embedding, grinding, polishing, etching, microscopy, and photo documentation.
  • Support mechanical testing activities on materials, components, or products according to defined test plans and procedures.
  • Conduct surface investigations and material characterization using available laboratory methods and equipment.
  • Record, organize, and evaluate test data accurately; prepare images, summaries, and test-related documentation.
  • Support general laboratory activities such as sample handling, equipment monitoring, consumables management, and test-order administration.
  • Collaborate with scientists, and cross-functional partners to communicate results and observations clearly.

Education:

  • Graduate or postgraduate technical/scientific degree program, such as mechanical engineering, life sciences or equivalent.

• Requirements:

  • Interest in metallurgy, material characterization, laboratory testing, and medical device or dental applications.
  • Familiarity with metallographic methods, mechanical testing, microscopy, surface investigation, or materials laboratory work is an advantage.
  • Ability to work carefully with technical documentation and follow detailed procedures and good documentation practice.
  • Good laboratory practice, including attention to safety, cleanliness, traceability, and accurate data recording.
  • Good organization skills and the ability to manage several laboratory tasks in parallel.
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written, and experienced with MS Office tools.
  • Knowledge of German is an advantage

Personal Attributes:

  • Collaborative attitude, flexible, agile and proactive
  • Analytical way of working, should have attention to detail and a strong sense of accuracy
  • Strong interpersonal skills (high empathy, active listening, motivated)
  • Strong commitment on achieving results
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, being able to communicate complex technical content / processes to different target audiences

Benefits of the internship:

  • Practical experience in the field of testing engineering and product development, being able to work in real world applications and projects
  • Shadowing, mentoring, and training opportunities with experienced engineers and professionals in the medical device/dental field
  • Opportunities to learn about various technical topics, including computer modeling and simulation, statistics, material science, manufacturing, design

Introduction

our notre site de Straumann Villeret SA (Villeret, Corgémont et Sonceboz), nous recherchons un·e Collaborateur·trice Service Infrastructure.

Dans ce rôle clé, vous contribuez activement à la continuité des activités du site en garantissant la sécurité, la disponibilité et la performance des infrastructures (bâtiments, installations techniques et énergie). Vous intervenez dans un environnement industriel exigeant où la fiabilité des installations est essentielle au bon fonctionnement de la production.

Vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe engagée et collaborez étroitement avec la maintenance, les prestataires externes et les différents départements du site.

Votre rôle

En tant que Collaborateur·trice Service Infrastructure, vous :

Sécurité & conformité

  • Contribuez activement à maintenir un environnement de travail sûr pour l’ensemble des collaborateurs et partenaires externes.
  • Assurez le bon fonctionnement des dispositifs de contrôle et de sécurité.
  • Intégrez la gestion des risques dans toutes vos interventions (maintenance, projets, améliorations continues).
  • Veillez au respect des règles EHS (Environnement, Hygiène, Sécurité).

Maintenance & exploitation des infrastructures

  • Supervisez et entretenez les installations techniques du bâtiment (chauffage, ventilation, traitement des eaux, eau pure/DI, etc.).
  • Réagissez aux alarmes et effectuez des interventions de dépannage pour garantir la disponibilité des équipements.
  • Participez aux maintenances préventives, correctives et amélioratives.
  • Analysez les dysfonctionnements techniques et proposez des améliorations structurées.
  • Coordonnez et suivez les interventions des entreprises externes.

Support opérationnel & logistique

  • Gérez les stocks de consommables et pièces de rechange en collaboration avec les départements concernés.
  • Approvisionnez les ateliers en consommables techniques.
  • Réalisez des travaux de manutention, de transport et de préparation des locaux selon les besoins.
  • Créez les ordres de maintenance et les demandes d’achats nécessaires.

Organisation & collaboration

  • Partagez les informations utiles à l’équipe et assurez un reporting régulier.
  • Collaborez étroitement avec la Maintenance et les autres départements pour coordonner les interventions.
  • Contribuez à une culture de collaboration, d’amélioration continue et de responsabilité partagée.

Ce poste implique des horaires flexibles, un travail en 2x8 ainsi que des interventions de piquet (nuit/week-end) selon les besoins opérationnels.

• Votre profil

• Exigences essentielles

  • Formation professionnelle (CFC ou titre équivalent) dans un domaine technique, idéalement lié aux infrastructures du bâtiment.
  • Expérience dans la maintenance technique ou l’exploitation d’installations industrielles.
  • Permis de conduire (véhicule léger).
  • Bonne maîtrise du français.
  • Disponibilité pour des horaires flexibles (2x8) et service de piquet.
  • Résidence permettant une intervention rapide sur site (délai d’intervention compatible avec les exigences opérationnelles).

Atouts

  • Connaissances en chauffage, ventilation, traitement des eaux ou installations industrielles.
  • Permis de cariste.
  • Connaissances d’anglais ou d’allemand.
  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques (Microsoft Office ou systèmes de gestion de maintenance).
